title: Added Driver Violation Points: Endorsement Deposit Schedule (Installment Payment Plans)
content:
| Company violation points of the most recent driver added to the Owner Auto Policy term | Added to the endorsement deposit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 10 percent of the endorsement balance |
| 1 to 5 | 5 percent of the endorsement balance |
| none, or no driver added | nothing |

**Scope.** This schedule of the **Installment Payment Plans** applies to the endorsement deposit taken on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan; the percentage is of the endorsement balance on which the deposit is taken.

**Records.** The points are those recorded with the driver addition on the Owner Auto Policy term. The most recent driver added is the driver addition with the latest change effective date on the owner term; of two added on the same date, the one recorded first.

**Edges.** 5 points takes 5 percent and 6 points takes 10 percent; 1 point takes 5 percent; 0 points takes nothing. *Hypothetically,* with an endorsement balance of 280.00 and a most recent added driver carrying 7 points, 28.00 is added.
